title: One human, 11 Claude agents, one game: the receipts (git history, real cost, what broke)
author: StudioMilesyon
selftext:
Solo dev here. I’m building Milesyon, a game studio tycoon from 1978 to 2026, in Rust with my own engine. The work is done by a team of Claude agents: one manager session that splits each request into written orders, workers that write the code, readers that only read, judges that try to prove the work wrong, and hooks they can’t skip (no commit without proof, no push without a token).

Real numbers: 3,252 commits, 88% co-authored with Claude, about $50,000 of compute since March at public API rates (on a subscription, so not my bill). The video also shows what broke.

Inside the game, a small local model reads the sentence you type and an open-weight image model paints your games’ covers, all offline.



Steam: 

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887470/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_campaign=claude\_v2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887470/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=claude_v2)  


AI disclosure: generative AI was used to make Milesyon.

* Development: the 3D models, textures, music and some sound effects were generated with AI tools. Code, texts and translations were written with an AI assistant (Claude), directed by me.
* In the game, on your own machine: a small open-weight language model reads the words of your sentence that the game's lexicon doesn't know, and answers as the Mentor; an open-weight image model paints your games' covers. Both run offline, nothing leaves your PC.
* In this video: the narration voice is AI generated (ElevenLabs). All footage is captured in game.
